about: The pointer's own image in the window list: WindowServer lists it as a window at the cursor level where it draws the pointer itself (09-30, the built-in display closed). Each example is answered the same by the core's is_pointer_picture (by owner name) and by the bench's pointers_image (by WindowServer's process): all three of layer, owner and size, so another window at the cursor level stays a cover. Numbers and the owner's name only; never a title.
